Based on a simplified, non-clinical-grade scoring system rather than a real ACMG assessment or ClinVar, this draft is currently classified as a Variant of Uncertain Significance (VUS) with medium confidence, especially since the consequence is not expected to alter protein function [2].

nonSignificantSummary.note: Remaining variants were not individually drafted — low-confidence, low/modifier-impact calls a real report also wouldn't discuss variant-by-variant. Counted here for completeness, not hidden.
